mixedPublishedOrigins: Published proofs and circuits source packages report different upstream commit ids. This package does not assert one checkout at one commit matches every preimage. Every seven existing-file preimage must match SOURCE-MEMBERSHIP before any apply.
sourceManifestPremises: proofs/Cargo.toml must have test autodiscovery and midnight-circuits dev-dependency as in published Cargo.toml.orig; no proofs manifest patch is included.
circuits/Cargo.toml preimage is published Cargo.toml.orig, not normalized registry Cargo.toml; explicit test target is appended literally.
Both crates must resolve the same local patched midnight-proofs instance; a second registry copy would not share the recorder TLS.
Intended feature matrix including circuit-params/committed-instances must be selected/checked before later execution.
registryNormalizedManifest: autotests=false belongs to generated normalized package metadata and is not silently patched or treated as the source-repository manifest.
